piece.headline: JOÃO PEDRO FEEDS 10 ARMBANDS, ISAK STARVES CHANDRU
piece.standfirst: Nikhil takes top spot, 7 clear of Aashiv, after João Pedro's armband landed for 10 managers while Chandru's Isak call fell flat.
piece.big_picture: Nikhil is top and Chandru has dropped to 6th after captaining Isak. João Pedro was the armband of choice for 10 managers and paid 24 each. Aashiv sits 7 behind, so the title race is on.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Naresh left 30 points on the bench. Bringing in João Pedro was smart, but too many of the points never counted. A painful one to look back on.
piece.one_to_watch: Nikhil leads Aashiv by 7 for the title. Aashiv played his Triple Captain this week, so if Nikhil's armband stumbles, the gap could close.

winners.name: Ravin
winners.verdict: Best score of the week and up to 3rd. João Pedro on the armband helped. Take the bow.

winners.name: Alia
winners.verdict: Bogle and Rogers in, Shaw and Mbeumo out, and the swap paid 21. Smart business.

losers.name: Vinesh
losers.verdict: Captained João Pedro and still finished bottom of the week. Harsh on him.

losers.name: Ravi Bhojwani
losers.verdict: Isak on the armband and a hit on transfers. A tough week, and 22nd stings.

losers.name: Chandru
losers.verdict: Triple Captain on Isak was the gamble, and the lead went. Now 6th.
